title: Live van tracking and ETA
journey: The driver starts a shift and the tracking engine writes the van's location on a cadence; the citizen's app resolves their ward to a route and watches only the vans on that route, computing an ETA from the remaining wards; the office's live map shows every van.

steps.action: Driver starts a shift; the tracking engine samples GPS and writes vans/{vanId}.lastLocation on the GPS_INTERVAL_SEC cadence, plus vans.batteryPct and vans.status = on_shift.
steps.notes: Direct Firestore write through the driver app's repositories, not a callable. The vanId claim scopes the write.

steps.action: The citizen's app resolves its wardId (device location inside a ward's center + radiusM, or manual picker) and reads wards/{wardId}.routeId to learn which route serves it.
steps.notes: The ward is resolved on the device and saved locally; the server never names the citizen's scope.

steps.action: The citizen's app watches vans where routeId == ward.routeId and status == on_shift, drawing a live marker per van.
steps.notes: Scoped by the routeId claim; the app never loads all vans.

steps.action: The citizen's app computes the ETA: sum of straight-line distances from the van through the remaining wards in routes.wardIds up to the user's ward, divided by AVG_VAN_SPEED_KMPH (fallback when speedKmph is below 5 km/h).
steps.notes: Prototype ETA method from PRD-1 section 0.13 Flow C. Names AVG_VAN_SPEED_KMPH explicitly.

steps.action: The office's live map shows every van in the staff member's ward scope, colored by van.status, with an offline badge when updatedAt is stale.
steps.notes: Read-only live view of the same van docs the citizen sees.

slices.evidence: lib/features/tracking/domain/tracking_engine.dart writes vans.lastLocation on a cadence via FirestoreVansRepository.updateLastLocation (lib/core/repositories/firestore/firestore_vans_repository.dart). Reads the real backend; not a callable.
apps/citizen_app/src/App.tsx renders vans from VanSimulationEngine and seed vans (src/core/seedData.ts); no real Firestore watch of vans exists in the user app.
slices.blockedBy: The user app reads seed/simulation data, not real Firestore vans. There is no onSnapshot of vans scoped by routeId; grep for collection('vans') returns only seedData and simulationService.

slices.evidence: src/App.tsx routes liveMap to A15_LiveMap; src/services/dataService.ts reads and writes localStorage under prefix safai_v3_, not Firebase.
slices.blockedBy: The admin panel has zero Firebase; its data layer is a pure localStorage mock, so the live map is not wired to the real backend.

handoffs.notes: The driver writes lastLocation; the citizen's app reads the same doc, scoped to its own ward's route.
The office sees the same van doc the citizen sees, filtered by its staff ward scope.

scenario.name: Live van map end-to-end (PRD-1 Test L1)
steps: Driver phone starts a shift on route R and the van marker appears in the user app within 15 seconds.
A second phone with the user app in a ward of route R shows the van moving.
A third phone with a user in a ward of a different route shows no van.
The admin Live Map shows the same van.

openQuestions: The user app's stack is React/Vite, not Flutter as the PRD states; the ETA computation lives in App.tsx but reads simulation data. Confirm the plan to replace it with a real Firestore watch of vans.
The user app's firebase project id is hardcoded to safai-saathi-panchmahal while the platform project is safaaisaathi-63a87; confirm which project the live-van query targets.
